name: bim-quality-rag-index-sample-v001
description: Conceptual sample index schema for BIM Data Quality & AI Readiness Assessment PoC Phase 3D. This schema is for design documentation only and is not intended for direct deployment to Azure AI Search.
notes: This file is a design sample only.
Azure AI Search is not implemented in Phase 3D.
Embedding generation and vector search are out of scope in Phase 3D.
No real project data, customer names, personal information, or confidential model data should be included.
Field attributes are simplified for architecture discussion.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for each RAG document or chunk.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Main searchable text used as LLM prompt context.
fields.example: ElementId 12345 has a Door quality issue related to RuleId D-002. Human review is required before using this data for AI or RAG.

fields.name: document_type
fields.description: Source document or data type.

fields.name: chunk_type
fields.description: Logical chunk unit for RAG retrieval.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Normalized BIM category.

fields.name: element_id
fields.description: Element reference ID. In future implementation, poc_element_id and revit_element_id may be separated.

fields.name: unique_id
fields.description: Revit UniqueId or anonymized UniqueId sample. Used as a stable Revit-side reference candidate.

fields.name: rule_id
fields.description: RuleId used to connect Element chunks, Rule Master chunks, and Fix Guide chunks.

fields.name: rule_name
fields.description: Human-readable rule name.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity of the quality issue in the PoC quality-check context.

fields.name: quality_score
fields.description: PoC quality score. This is a data quality indicator, not a design or construction quality judgment.

fields.name: ai_readiness_score
fields.description: AI readiness score for BI, analytics, generative AI, or RAG use.

fields.name: ai_readiness_level
fields.description: AI readiness level label.

fields.name: human_review_required
fields.description: Whether human review is required before relying on the information.

fields.name: fix_priority
fields.description: Temporary fix priority label. Detailed training data design is handled in Phase 3E.

fields.name: family_name
fields.description: Anonymized or sample Revit family name. Do not include confidential project-specific family names in public samples.

fields.name: type_name
fields.description: Anonymized or sample Revit type name. Do not include confidential project-specific type names in public samples.

fields.name: level_name
fields.description: Level or floor name associated with the element when available.

fields.name: room_name
fields.description: Room name when the chunk is related to a Room element. For Door elements, this may be blank in the initial MVP.

fields.name: room_number
fields.description: Room number when available. For Door elements, this may be blank in the initial MVP.

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Original source file path used to create the chunk.

fields.name: generated_date
fields.description: Generation date of the chunk or sample document.

out_of_scope_for_phase3d: Azure OpenAI or OpenAI API connection
